description: In front of you there’s a wicker basket filled with bread and fruit on a red cloth, and a light green plate holding a red apple, two small dark cherries/berries, and a green lime. The left hand moves in from the lower right toward the basket, reaches in and grasps a small red strawberry as the left-hand object, then lifts it out and carries it rightward to the plate before setting it down near the apple and releasing it so the hand withdraws.
